paragraphs: After serving thirty years, aging gangster Big Dolly Palakka returns to Chicago determined to kill former associate Frankie for the life he imagines Frankie enjoyed while Dolly was in prison. Instead he finds old underworld figures diminished by age and Frankie preoccupied with his daughter's respectable wedding and family troubles. Dolly arrives armed for the long-promised showdown, but Frankie's household punctures both men's old gangster posturing.
